topic: Task ledger and queue events filtered by space (left to SP-026)
detail: RC-704 asked SP-029 to add a task's dispatch space to the ledger. SP-026 (events, digest, ListTasks, GetTask carry a space set at creation and are filtered) owns the ledger and the readers, so SP-029 only sets the space at creation where it derives content: the queue completion event now carries 'space' (and 'task_id'), and a task's session pin carries the dispatch space. The ledger column (a migration), filtering the queue stream for sessions, and what orchd's own PR-review tasks read remain for SP-026.
note: SP-026 (PR #200, merged) filters the queue stream and the task ledger by the space set at creation (events.Event.Space, set by notifyTaskDone); this covers the follow-up. Recorded 2026-11-15 when #200 was merged into #196.
